verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing channels: the Online Filing Centre web portal and PDF forms by email or mail. A passing fee line mentions a 'registered intermediary', but nothing documents a system-to-system interface, system accounts, a transmitter or batch program, or a published enrollment path. The probe found no transactional registry API on any surface checked; the keyless open.canada.ca CKAN API it reached is a separate national open-data platform and does not count toward this story.
